classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a verbatim transcript of a National Council debate with speakers listed and a date of the debate expressed.
classification.resume: The document is a parliamentary postulate concerning the implementation of children's right to be heard under Article 12 of the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child in Switzerland, presented during a National Council debate on 8 September 2014. It records the speakers involved in the debate and is part of the video recordings of National Council proceedings from the autumn session of 2014.
